title: Fylgja API, version 1
description: M13: what crosses the API beside the documents Fylgja already versions. A request is $defs/request with the args of its operation ($defs/args). An answer is application/x-ndjson, each line one $defs/frame, the last a document frame whose document is findings.schema.json's, unchanged at findings_version 1. A transport fault's body is $defs/problem. The CTM, the bundle and a support package cross inside $defs/file, as bytes, and are validated by their own schemas (ctm.schema.json, manifest.schema.json, psp.schema.json), never here. No token, login, configuration line or device diff appears in any of these. 014: the operations stage.list and stage.plan replace waypoint.list and waypoint.plan, and twin.create, twin.step and intent.read take stage where they took waypoint; the version stays 1, since the API is pre-1.0 and every other operation is unchanged. 015: the operation twin.rehearse (its args the branch; an interrupt from its start, whose workflow is fylgja-rehearse), and the rendering markdown, whose document frame carries the report as markdown beside its text on twin.rehearse alone; the version stays 1, since a client of M13 ignores a new operation, a render value it does not send and a frame field it does not know.

render.description: The rendering the client asks for beside the document: text is what the command printed without --json at M12; json is what it wrote to stderr under --json; markdown (015) is text's frames, and on twin.rehearse the document frame's markdown beside its text, every other operation answering it as it answers text. Absent: no out or err frame and no document text.

args.description: The command's arguments as given, one of $defs/args by the operation the path names. An absent key is a flag that was not given.

files.description: twin.compile: the CTM, under the path given. twin.provision: every regular file of the bundle directory, each under its slash-separated path inside it. psp.validate: each package, under the path given, in order.

args.description: The arguments of each operation. Every key is optional on the wire but two: a required flag that is missing is refused by the server under M12's identifier and wording. twin.provision's bundle, which M12's command took as its one argument, is required, and twin.verify's args are given only beside wait; the server refuses a request without either as 400, the request is not one.

stage.description: --stage as given, <branch>/<label> (014); present and empty is --stage=

interval.description: --interval as given; present and empty is --interval=

bundle.description: The bundle directory as the operator gave it, for the subject and every sentence that names it. The server opens no path a client names.

stage.description: --stage as given: the target, in place of the next stage of the twin's proposed change

wait.description: --wait as given; present and empty is --wait=
--wait's value: the default budget when the flag was given bare

args.description: The words a bare --wait leaves as arguments, which the server refuses as verify.wait.invalid

branch.description: --branch as given, a proposed change's source branch (014); present and empty is --branch=
--branch as given; required, which the server refuses as --branch is required
--branch as given, the proposed change's source branch (015); required, which the server refuses as --branch is required; present and empty is --branch=, refused stage.ref.invalid

frame.description: One line of an answer. A frame's kind is its key. A client ignores a kind it does not know.

out.description: Text for stdout, whole lines, as M12 printed them. Under render text alone.

err.description: Text for stderr, whole lines. Under either rendering.

start.description: The server begins to start this run. From here an interrupt call reaches it, on an operation that takes one: twin.destroy's start opens no stream, and its answer has no run frame.

files.description: intent.read: one file, ctm.json, the CTM. twin.compile: every file of the bundle, each under its path inside it.

text.description: Under render text or markdown, when the document has findings: they as text, for stderr, as M12's report printed them.

markdown.description: 015: under render markdown, on twin.rehearse alone, the report as GitHub-flavoured markdown, rendered from the document and the plan's steps; a rendering, never part of the document. Absent on every other operation and rendering.

event.description: One step boundary of a run, or one notice about a run, read from the run's history (M2's progress event).

step.description: As the progress line names it: read, readiness n1, cleanup teardown

finding_step.description: The step as findings name it, when it has one

problem.description: The body of a transport fault: 401, 404, 413, 400, 409. The status says which.
